name: gemini-mcp
description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini image models (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) via natural language prompts

gemini_image_model.title: Gemini Image Model
gemini_image_model.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-3.1-flash-image)

gemini_output_dir.title: Output Directory
gemini_output_dir.description: Default directory for generated images (default: ~/Downloads/gemini-mcp). When set, a per-call output_dir must be inside it.

gemini_input_dir.title: Input Directory
gemini_input_dir.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against (e.g. an uploads folder)

gemini_upload_dir.title: Upload Directory
gemini_upload_dir.description: Only allow local files inside this directory (or several, separated by : or ; on Windows) to be uploaded to the Gemini Files API. Also confines reference images when Reference Image Directory is blank. Leave blank for no restriction.

gemini_reference_dir.title: Reference Image Directory
gemini_reference_dir.description: Only allow local reference images (the images / image paths sent to Gemini) from inside this directory (or several, separated by : or ; on Windows). Output Directory is always allowed too. Blank: falls back to Upload Directory; if that is blank too, no restriction.

gemini_timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout (ms)
gemini_timeout_ms.description: Upstream request timeout in ms (default: 60000, or 120000 for 4K output)

gemini_heartbeat_ms.title: Heartbeat Interval (ms)
gemini_heartbeat_ms.description: Progress-notification cadence in ms while a generation runs (default: 10000; 0 disables) — keeps MCP hosts that reset their timeout on progress from timing out long generations

gemini_chain_retry_ms.title: Chain Retry Window (ms)
gemini_chain_retry_ms.description: How long to wait out interactions-store lag when a chained call 404s (default: 120000; 0 disables retrying)

gemini_debug.title: Debug Diagnostics
gemini_debug.description: When set, emit heartbeat diagnostics to stderr. Off by default.

gemini_rate_card.title: Rate Card Override (JSON)
gemini_rate_card.description: Override/extend the shipped USD-per-1M-token rates used by gemini_token_usage's cost estimate, e.g. {"gemini-3-pro-image":{"input":2,"text_output":12,"image_output":120}}. Malformed JSON is ignored (a bad card must not fail generations).

tools.name: gemini_list_models
tools.description: List available Gemini image models and the current default

tools.name: gemini_image_generate
tools.description: Generate image(s) from a text prompt

tools.name: gemini_image_edit
tools.description: Edit or compose one or more input images with a text instruction (one-off edits; for a series of edits use gemini_interact)

tools.name: gemini_image_set
tools.description: Generate a master image plus N consistent images referencing it

tools.name: gemini_interact
tools.description: Preferred tool for iterative image refinement: multi-turn generation/editing via the Interactions API — chain the returned interaction_id via previous_interaction_id

tools.name: gemini_video_generate
tools.description: Generate a short video (text→video, image→video, interpolation, edit or extend) via the Gemini omni model, at 360p-4k; written to disk as MP4

tools.name: gemini_music_generate
tools.description: Generate music from a text prompt via a Lyria model (clip, 3.5 or pro); single-turn; written to disk as MP3

tools.name: gemini_get_result
tools.description: Fetch an async generation started with async: true, by its job_id

tools.name: gemini_token_usage
tools.description: Token usage for this session so far — call before and after a workflow to attribute its cost

tools.name: gemini_upload_file
tools.description: Upload an image (or video/audio) to the Gemini Files API once — from a url, base64, or local path — and get a reusable files/<id> reference (~48h)

tools.name: gemini_list_files
tools.description: List files currently uploaded to the Gemini Files API under this API key

tools.name: gemini_delete_file
tools.description: Delete an uploaded Gemini file before its ~48h expiry

tools.name: gemini_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the API key and Gemini reachability: resolves the key the way real tools do, lists models once, and reports whether a key resolved, whether Google accepted it, and a hint telling those apart.
